npc.chief.name: Village Chief
npc.merchant.name: Traveling Merchant
npc.guard.name: Gate Guard
dialogue.chief.greet: Welcome, traveler. This is Creekside Village.
dialogue.chief.ask: What would you like to know?
dialogue.chief.about_village: Our village is small but peaceful. The fountain and the old statue in the plaza are our pride.
dialogue.chief.about_bridge: A creek runs through the heart of the village. Cross that wooden bridge and you'll reach the east gate.
dialogue.chief.farewell: Go on, look around. Come back any time.
dialogue.merchant.greet: Oh, a customer! I've plenty of fine wares — take a look.
dialogue.merchant.buy: Good eye! This potion, I'll give it to you at a special price.
dialogue.merchant.rumor: They say a strange light was seen beyond the hill. Well, business comes first for me.
dialogue.merchant.farewell: Come again! I'll always be right here.
dialogue.guard.greet: Halt. The gate beyond the bridge requires a pass.
dialogue.guard.choice.stay: I'll just look around the village
dialogue.guard.allow: A guest of the chief? Very well. Travel safely.
dialogue.guard.stay: A wise choice. The village is safe — look around all you like.
ui.title: Creekside Village
